challenge.better_approach: RuntimeMaxSec on the starter would kill a long proof's bus mid-run. An exit when --home vanishes is already built (server.py:822) and never fired. Making callers trap-rm their homes is policy, not physics. Idle-exit is the one that bounds the leak and still serves a long proof.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a long proof never leaves its scratch bus with nothing open for N seconds. Unmeasured: bus.log has no ask timing, so N is labeled a hypothesis and D2 records idle_s_max so the next reading can set it.
challenge.prior_art: Idea 2026-11-14-orphan-census (a leaked scratch bus on akienasus, same shape). ea6e465680a3 (shim proof leaves a scratch process), 5a91bdac03b7 (a foreign spawn at the live home), 1029d5146152 and b69e5c658b1c (the exit path). Grepped tickets and questions for idle, RuntimeMaxSec and idles out: none bounds a scratch bus by idleness.
challenge.real_collision: None. The tester's CollectMode stop and the idle exit end through the same stop path; whichever comes first wins and the other finds nothing to stop.

answers.falsifier: A scratch bus idle past N exits with cause idle and the live bus does not; nothing standing is lost across the exit and respawn; N defaults to 1800 and each stop record carries the longest idle gap.
answers.how: In _HomeWatch.service_actions, beside the home-gone check: if the server is scratch, no connection is open, nothing is in flight or undelivered, and the last connection closed more than CAIRN_BUS_IDLE_S (default 1800, a hypothesis) ago, then stop.set('idle') and shut down. Every stop record carries idle_s_max.
answers.traces_to: CP4 via the bus charter's lazy-init why (a sleeping component costs nothing until a message arrives; the next ask respawns it) and Law 7 (the exit is recorded with its cause).
answers.what: A --scratch bus that no caller has reached for N seconds, holding no ask and no undelivered mail, ends itself; the live house bus never does.

bullets.text: Two of the 31 leaked units were akienasus_cc_0's own castsplice script; the first reading's 'every home missing' was refuted by ls.
